android.desc:
YOUR CHART IS FREE AND STAYS FREE.

Astro93 is a personal astrology companion built on a simple promise: the astronomy is free, private, and works offline. Your natal chart, today's transits, and the lunar calendar are computed entirely on your device with professional-grade planetary math. No account, no ads, no trackers, no internet required.

WHAT'S FREE, FOREVER
• Full natal chart (birth chart): Sun through Pluto plus Chiron and the North Node, Ascendant and Midheaven, houses and aspects on a beautiful chart wheel
• Precise daily transits to your own chart: real astrology, not a generic zodiac horoscope
• Your week ahead: a short reading of the coming week, free every week
• Lunar calendar: Moon phases, New and Full Moons, sign ingresses, and void-of-course windows
• Multiple birth profiles: family, friends, partners
• Works with unknown birth time (chart without houses)
• Four house systems (Placidus, Whole Sign, Koch, Equal) plus adjustable aspect orbs
• Type a birthplace and Astro93 finds the coordinates
• A calm, dark design made for late-night sky reading

READINGS (AI), AND WHY THEY ARE PAID
Readings are written by AI from your actual chart:
• A daily morning briefing woven from your real transits. It remembers previous days, so a week-long Pluto transit reads as ongoing inner work, not a daily "revelation".
• Brief, Balanced or In depth: you choose how much astrology your briefing has
• A notification in the morning when your briefing is ready, if you want one
• Tap any transit, placement, or aspect for a warm, psychologically grounded interpretation
• Listen to your readings in a natural voice
• A complete natal analysis: a keepsake reading of your whole chart, exportable as PDF, also available as a one-time purchase with no subscription

Every new user gets 3 free days of Readings. They start on their own when you set up your chart: no card, nothing to cancel. During the free days you can read the opening of your natal analysis; the whole of it comes with a subscription or the one-time purchase.

And the honest part: only the AI is paid, because it costs us too. Everything the app can compute itself stays free, forever.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your birth data lives on your device. No account, no login, no analytics, no advertising SDKs. Only two things ever touch the network: AI readings and birthplace lookup.
